reason: The dekkene owner is my neighbour and lets me pay at the end of the month, so I don't need cash up front. I don't drive, so someone would still have to go down to a pickup point between 6 and 8, and my son already brings the shopping.
objection: No home delivery, and I'd have to pay cash or Whish on the spot. I'm not going to give up my neighbour's end-of-month credit to save a few cents.
would_change_my_mind: If it came to my door or my son could collect it easily, and I could pay at the end of the month like at the dekkene.
